vibe_rationale: Authentic skate community jam running since 2001, free and community-rooted, but single-scene and backed by an energy drink brand.
fit_notes: Canberra's strongest skate event, but no age data is published and the crowd leans youthful, with weak wellness adjacency apart from a possible skater-care zone. Monster Energy, Nike SB and Independent Trucks already hold the brand space, so High Ground would need a non-competing recovery or first-aid role approached through the volunteer organisers.
